svg.text: CONTROLS AND MIDI - the control hub, the knobs, the screen, MIDI IN
The Codec Zero uses GPIO 2, 3 (I2C, shared), 18-21 (audio), 23, 24 and 27. Everything here uses other pins. Part numbers match board-hub.svg.
Each wire from the pin's underside goes
to the hub's pad of the same number
(P1, P3 ... P37), and on from there.
Swap the outer two wires if a knob runs
MIDI IN - opto-isolated, as the MIDI spec has it
MIDI RX is the Pi's serial port, at 31250 baud: in config.txt, dtoverlay=midi-uart0 and
dtoverlay=disable-bt, and the serial console off in raspi-config. A USB MIDI device can also go in
the USB socket on the right side.
The panel: encoder, footswitches, TEMPO LED
(the middle pin of A, C, B)
